LTSR.description: Limiting Slenderness Ratio (LTSR). Keyed by element id (the element must already exist in the model); holds the per-element allowable slenderness ratio limits for compression and tension members used in AIJ-ASD02 steel member design checks. Requires the AIJ-ASD02 steel design code to be activated first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. DELETE removes the limit assignment from the element.

bNOTCHECK.description: Do not check the slenderness ratio for this element. When true, the compression and tension limits are ignored.

COMP.description: Allowable (limiting) slenderness ratio for compression members.

TENS.description: Allowable (limiting) slenderness ratio for tension members.
